spec.title: Attention as a soft lookup
spec.aria: A query [1,0] scores three keys as 1, 0, 1, exponentials give 2.718, 1, 2.718 with sum 6.436, softmax weights are 0.422, 0.155, 0.422, and the weighted values give context [6.335, 3.665].
